                          [--model MODEL] [--clip-len N] [--num-points N]
                          [--radius RADIUS] [--nsamples NSAMPLES]
                          [--spatial-stride SPATIAL_STRIDE]
                          [--temporal-kernel-size TEMPORAL_KERNEL_SIZE]
                          [--temporal-stride TEMPORAL_STRIDE] [--dim DIM]
                          [--depth DEPTH] [--heads HEADS]
                          [--dim-head DIM_HEAD] [--mlp-dim MLP_DIM]
                          [--dropout1 DROPOUT1] [--dropout2 DROPOUT2]
                          [-b BATCH_SIZE] [--epochs N] [-j N] [--lr LR]
                          [--momentum M] [--wd W]
                          [--lr-milestones LR_MILESTONES [LR_MILESTONES ...]]
                          [--lr-gamma LR_GAMMA]
                          [--lr-warmup-epochs LR_WARMUP_EPOCHS]
                          [--print-freq PRINT_FREQ] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                          [--resume RESUME] [--start-epoch N]

P4Transformer Model Training

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --data-path DATA_PATH
                        dataset
  --seed SEED           random seed
  --model MODEL         model
  --clip-len N          number of frames per clip
  --num-points N        number of points per frame
  --radius RADIUS       radius for the ball query
  --nsamples NSAMPLES   number of neighbors for the ball query
  --spatial-stride SPATIAL_STRIDE
                        spatial subsampling rate
  --temporal-kernel-size TEMPORAL_KERNEL_SIZE
                        temporal kernel size
  --temporal-stride TEMPORAL_STRIDE
                        temporal stride
  --dim DIM             transformer dim
  --depth DEPTH         transformer depth
  --heads HEADS         transformer head
  --dim-head DIM_HEAD   transformer dim for each head
  --mlp-dim MLP_DIM     transformer mlp dim
  --dropout1 DROPOUT1   transformer dropout
  --dropout2 DROPOUT2   classifier dropout
  -b BATCH_SIZE, --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
  --epochs N            number of total epochs to run
  -j N, --workers N     number of data loading workers (default: 16)
  --lr LR               initial learning rate
  --momentum M          momentum
  --wd W, --weight-decay W
                        weight decay (default: 1e-4)
  --lr-milestones LR_MILESTONES [LR_MILESTONES ...]
                        decrease lr on milestones
  --lr-gamma LR_GAMMA   decrease lr by a factor of lr-gamma
  --lr-warmup-epochs LR_WARMUP_EPOCHS
                        number of warmup epochs
  --print-freq PRINT_FREQ
                        print frequency
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        path where to save
  --resume RESUME       resume from checkpoint
  --start-epoch N       start epoch
